title: Paperclip scientists work on the Magenta craft
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Paperclip scientists work on the Magenta craft, about post-1945 at Wright-Patterson AFB, Dayton, Ohio, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Many of the top Nazi scientists as a part of Operation Paperclip that the Allies had exfiltrated also made their way to Wright Patterson to work on the magenta craft.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that after World War Two, many top Nazi scientists were brought out of Germany by the Allies under Operation Paperclip, a program that put German scientists to work for the United States. He says some of them went to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio to work on what he calls the Magenta craft, a UFO said to have crashed in Italy. If true, it would mean captured German experts helped study a crashed craft.
